label: b4-binding-1
text:
Node binding-1 (6 of 6): make the agent's Claude Code run the checks of R2, R1, R3, R4, R8 (/opt/enforce/checks/R2, /opt/enforce/checks/R1, /opt/enforce/checks/R3, /opt/enforce/checks/R4, /opt/enforce/checks/R8) at Stop, in /workspace/.claude/settings.json: the project's settings, which load for the agent in /workspace and not for your own session; hooks that other rules' bindings already put there stay. The hook reads the reply: last_assistant_message in the hook's input; it runs every check on every file it reads (or on the reply) and reports all their violations in one message; on a violation it should decision "block" with the check's message (a filter gives the fixed text in it): the agent writes the reply again. Block only the violation, so the agent can fix its work and go on.
Done when: `/opt/enforce-harness/try --check` reports nothing, and each test case of R2, R1, R3, R4, R8, given to the hooks as the agent would make it (written by a file tool and by a shell command, or sent as the reply), is blocked with a message naming its rule when it breaks the rule, and passes when it follows it. The harness checks this when you reply.
